case.title: 'Tomorrow' resolves to the correct calendar date in the tool call
case.source: calleval: relative dates + ElevenLabs prompting guide (elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-agents/best-practices/prompting-guide) (state tool parameter formats)
case.goal: Book an appointment for tomorrow at 10 AM, any doctor and branch
case.precondition: Customer only used the word 'tomorrow' for the date.
criteria: The agent booked the correct calendar date for 'tomorrow' (the call's current date plus one day)

turns.text: Hi, this is Maya from Apollo Hospitals. How can I help you?
I want to book an appointment for tomorrow at ten in the morning.
We have Dr. Rajendra Prasad for General Medicine and Dr. Akram Syed for Pediatrics. Whom would you like to see?
I don't mind, either doctor is fine.
We have slots available at 10:00 AM with Dr. Rajendra Prasad at Indiranagar, or at 10:00 AM with Dr. Akram Syed at Koramangala. Which branch would you prefer?
Any branch is fine, whichever has the opening.
Could you confirm your full name for the booking?
I have booked your appointment for tomorrow at 10:00 AM at Indiranagar with Dr. Rajendra Prasad. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that is all. Thanks, bye.
Thank you for calling Apollo Clinic. Have a wonderful day!
